question: What physical platforms can be used to study the quantum properties of phonons?

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: Identifies optomechanical nanomechanical/nanobeam resonators as a platform where non-classical correlations between single photons and phonons have been demonstrated, enabling study of phonon quantum properties.
examples: non-classical photon–phonon pairs from a nanomechanical resonator
nano-optomechanical resonators as photon–phonon quantum interfaces
on-chip optomechanical devices for quantum phononics

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: Mentions micromachined silicon-beam optomechanical resonators (e.g., on separate chips ~20 cm apart) that can be entangled via an optical field near 1,550 nm and integrated into fibre-optic quantum networks.
examples: entanglement between two silicon micromechanical oscillators on separate chips 20 cm apart
micromachined optomechanical resonators operating at telecom wavelengths (~1,550 nm)
mechanical oscillators entangled through an optical field in a quantum network

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: Identifies superconducting qubits coupled to mechanical oscillators as a quantum phonon platform, e.g., strong dispersive coupling of a fluxonium qubit to a subgigahertz mechanical oscillator, including circuit quantum acoustodynamics (cQAD) with transmons.
examples: strong dispersive coupling between a fluxonium qubit and a subgigahertz mechanical oscillator
circuit quantum acoustodynamics: superconducting qubit coupled to mechanical oscillator
coupling exceeding decoherence rates of both qubit and oscillator

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: Notes the demonstrated single-phonon-level capabilities of these platforms: conditional Fock-state preparation (>85% fidelity), long-lived storage and retrieval of non-classical single-phonon states, phonon-number-resolved measurement, and time-dependent coherence measurements.
examples: conditional mechanical Fock-state preparation with >85% fidelity
storage and retrieval of non-classical single-phonon states with lifetimes improved by ~two orders of magnitude
phonon-number-resolved measurements via the coupled qubit

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: Explains that in cQAD schemes the qubit–mechanics coupling is mediated by piezoelectricity, with transmon qubits resonantly coupled to mechanical oscillators typically at 2–8 GHz.
examples: piezoelectricity mediates resonant coupling between transmon qubits and mechanical oscillators
cQAD demonstrations operating between 2 and 8 GHz
piezoelectric transduction between superconducting circuits and phononic modes

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: Discusses that studying phonons at hundreds of MHz is valuable for quantum sensing and networking components, and that maintaining coupling at these frequencies requires different qubit types such as fluxonium rather than transmons.
examples: fluxonium enables strong coupling at hundreds-of-MHz mechanical frequencies
fluxonium avoids diminishing coupling for low-frequency oscillators with minimal gate capacitance
moving to lower frequencies compels a different qubit than the transmon

ingredients.name: valuable_2
ingredients.criterion: States that optomechanical resonators are promising quantum memory candidates given long storage lifetimes of non-classical phonon states.
examples: nano-optomechanical resonators as quantum memories
long lifetimes of stored non-classical single-phonon states

ingredients.name: valuable_3
ingredients.criterion: Mentions that single-particle photon–phonon conversion supports mechanically transduced microwave-to-optical quantum conversion, and that telecom-band optomechanical platforms enable entanglement distribution in fibre-optic quantum networks based on silicon photonics.
examples: mechanically transduced microwave-to-optical conversion in the quantum domain
large-area quantum networks based on silicon photonics
entanglement distribution in the conventional telecommunication band
